en.headline: Government invites industry interest for first Hung Shui Kiu logistics sites
en.dek: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said the initial batch of e-commerce logistics plots offers flexible development options and could reach the market by late 2027 or early 2028.
body: The government this week invited expressions of interest from the industry for the first batch of selected sites in the Hung Shui Kiu / Ha Tsuen New Development Area modern logistics circle, Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said.

About 32 hectares have been reserved and divided into five functional zones covering high-value cargo, e-commerce logistics, freight forwarding and low-altitude economy, a smart green mass-transit depot and future expansion. The current invitation covers five plots, of which the three e-commerce logistics sites form the initial batch and can be developed individually or combined into larger parcels.

Chan said the exercise aims to gauge genuine market demand so that appropriate land terms and development models can be drawn up. A briefing will be held for interested parties to present concrete proposals. Sites are expected to be released at the earliest by the end of 2027 or early 2028.

On supporting transport, she noted that the first-stage road works contract for the Hung Shui Kiu smart green mass-transit system is under tender evaluation, with construction targeted to start in 2027 and completion in 2031 to match the opening. The system’s procurement and operation contract will also be tendered this year. The Kai Tak smart green mass-transit tender, which closed on Friday, attracted two bids.

zh.headline: 政府就洪水橋物流圈首批用地邀請業界提交意向書
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，首批電商物流用地具彈性，可個別或合併發展，預計最快2027年底或2028年初推出。
body: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，當局正推進本港物流業的長遠用地發展，本周已就洪水橋／厦村新發展區現代物流圈的首批選定地塊邀請業界提交意向書，預計最快可於2027年底或2028年初推出。
洪水橋物流圈預留約32公頃土地，劃分為高價值貨物物流區、電商物流區、貨運代理及低空經濟區等五大功能區域。今次邀請涵蓋當中5幅用地，其中電商物流區的3幅用地屬首批發展，極具彈性，可個別發展或合併成較大面積土地。
陳美寶指，希望藉意向書切實掌握市場需求，以制訂合適的土地條款及發展模式，並會舉行簡介會，邀請業界就選定地塊說明具體發展方案。
交通配套方面，洪水橋智慧綠色集體運輸系統第一階段道路工程合約正進行評標，預計2027年動工、2031年完成以配合通車；系統採購及營運合約亦將於今年招標。啟德智慧綠色集體運輸系統昨已截標，接獲兩份標書。
